description: Delete one or more interpolables from the timeline, keyframes included. Ids come from studio_timeline_get_state. Nothing is applied to the scene: the objects keep the pose the timeline last left them in. This is not undoable through Studio's undo stack — Timeline keeps its own history, separate from Studio's. Requires the Timeline plugin.

id.description: one interpolable id, or a list of them; every id is checked before anything is removed

output.description: same shape as studio_timeline_get_state, interpolables listed without their keyframes
